title: Bitcoin Depot Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: Bitcoin Depot Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a cybersecurity incident discovered on March 23, 2026, in which an unauthorized party accessed IT systems and transferred approximately 50.903 Bitcoin (valued at ~$3.665 million) from Company-controlled wallets without authorization. The company determined on April 6, 2026 that the incident met the threshold for material disclosure under Item 1.05 of Form 8-K. The incident is believed contained to the corporate environment and did not affect customer platforms.
key_points: Cybersecurity incident discovered on March 23, 2026; unauthorized actor gained access to IT systems and digital asset settlement account credentials
Approximately 50.903 Bitcoin transferred without authorization, valued at approximately $3.665 million as of incident date
Company believes incident was contained to corporate environment; customer platforms, divisions, systems, and data unaffected
No evidence of customer PII accessed or exfiltrated; investigation ongoing
Company determined on April 6, 2026 that incident is material under Item 1.05 of Form 8-K
Incident not expected to have material impact on financial condition or results of operations; insurance coverage may apply
